data.name: 1,3-Dibromobenzene with Water
measurement_methods: The 1,3-dibromobenzene solubility was determined by ultraviolet spectrophotometric measurements using a Beckman DU spectrophotometer.
mixing_methods: An excess of 1,3-dibromobenzene was added to a 4 ml of water in an ampoule which was then sealed.
The sealed ampoule was rotated in a constant temperature water bath for a week to establish saturation.

publication_references.citation: Hine, J.; Haworth, H.W.; Ramsay, O.B., J. Am. Chem. Soc. 1963, 85(10), 1473-6.
